blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) on Thursday said vendors whose stalls will have to be temporarily closed as part of security measures being implemented for the Asean Summit next week will each get P10,000 in financial aid and family food packs. In a statement, Social Welfare Secretary Rex Gatchalian assured that assistance will be given to affected vendors and food stall owners in Pasay City and Paranaque City, noting that payouts have already started on Sunday. “While we apologize to those whose livelihoods have been stalled due to the upcoming Asean Summit, the directive of our president […]...
